questions.question: When young Samuel kept hearing a voice at night, what did Eli tell him to say if it called again?

answers.text: Speak LORD because Your servant is listening

questions.question: The LORD told young Samuel He would judge Eli's house. What was the reason?

answers.text: His sons blasphemed God and he did not restrain them
He stopped offering the yearly sacrifices at the temple
He let the lamp of God go out in the temple

questions.question: The LORD told Samuel that enough sacrifices and offerings could still atone for the iniquity of Eli's house. True or false?
As young Samuel grew up, all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew he was confirmed as what?
